map.快递服务质量品控指标计算，输入业务数据自动计算丢失率/延误率/损毁率/申诉率，对: Express service quality control metrics calculator. Enter business data to automatically compute loss rate / delay rate / damage rate / appeal rate and rate the grade against the YZ/T 0168 standard.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：comp÷total×1000000；delayed: Core formulas (by input variable): comp÷total×1000000; delayed÷total×100; damaged÷total×100
map.快递服务品控指标计算工具，输入处理量、丢失/延误/损毁/申诉件数，自动计算四项品: An express service quality control metrics calculator. Enter the handled volume and the counts of lost, delayed, damaged and appealed items to automatically compute four quality control rates and rate the grade against the YZ/T 0168 standard.
map.快递网点月度品控考核: Monthly QC assessment for express outlets
map.📚 深度解析：品控（操作/质量/检查）流程: 📚 Deep dive: Quality Control (Operation / Quality / Inspection) Process
map.快递网点在月度考核时录入总处理量与丢失/延误/损毁/申诉件数，自动算四项品控率并: For monthly assessment, an express outlet enters total volume and the counts of lost, delayed, damaged and appealed items, automatically computing four quality control rates and checking them against the YZ/T 0168 limits to see whether they pass.
map.服务质量改进复盘时，对比不同周期（月/季/年）品控等级变化，定位持续超标的环节重: When reviewing service quality improvement, compare quality control grades across different periods (month / quarter / year) to locate the stages that persistently exceed limits and focus remediation there.
map.对内审或监管检查，一键生成品控报告（含标准限值、实测值与 A–E 等级），作为合: For internal audits or regulator inspections, generate a quality control report with one click (including standard limits, measured values and A–E grades) as compliance record material.
map.总处理量 10 万件、丢失 3 件、延误 20 件、损毁 15 件、有效申诉 1: Total volume 100 000 items, lost 3, delayed 20, damaged 15, valid appeals 1, satisfaction 96%: loss rate 0.003%, delay rate 0.02%, damage rate 0.015%, valid appeal rate 1 item per million, all four pass, overall grade "Good (Grade B)".
map.标准限值从哪来？: Where do the standard limits come from?
map.丢失率≤0.01%、延误率≤0.05%、损毁率≤0.03%、有效申诉率≤2 件/: Loss rate ≤0.01%, delay rate ≤0.05%, damage rate ≤0.03%, valid appeal rate ≤2 items per million, based on the YZ/T 0168 national standard for express services; satisfaction ≥95% distinguishes Grade A from Grade B. For formal assessment, always defer to the latest standard text.
map.四项指标全达标且满意度≥95% 为优秀（A级），全达标为良好（B级），达标 3: All four metrics passing with satisfaction ≥95% is Excellent (Grade A); all four passing is Good (Grade B); three passing is Qualified (Grade C); two is Basically Qualified (Grade D); fewer than two is Unqualified (Grade E).
map.快件总丢失率依据YZ/T 0168应≤0.01%: Total parcel loss rate should be ≤0.01% per YZ/T 0168
map.快件总延误率依据YZ/T 0168应≤0.05%: Total parcel delay rate should be ≤0.05% per YZ/T 0168
map.快件总损毁率依据YZ/T 0168应≤0.03%: Total parcel damage rate should be ≤0.03% per YZ/T 0168
map.有效申诉率应≤2件/百万件: Valid appeal rate should be ≤2 items per million
map.品控数据应按月统计并持续改进: Quality control data should be compiled monthly and continuously improved
